question: In a Young double-slit experiment, the slit spacing is 0.50 mm, the screen is 2 m away and the wavelength is 500 nm. A transparent film of refractive index 1.50 and thickness 2 micrometres covers the upper slit. Using the paraxial approximation, draw the setup and find the fringe spacing, added phase difference and displacement of the tracked zero-order fringe. Is the original screen center bright or dark, and does the final unlabeled intensity pattern differ from before?

derived.sourceText: y₀ = L(n−1)t/d = (2)(1e-6)/(5e-4) = 4e-3 m, toward covered (upper) slit

turnPlan.question: In a Young double-slit experiment, the slit spacing is 0.50 mm, the screen is 2 m away and the wavelength is 500 nm. A transparent film of refractive index 1.50 and thickness 2 micrometres covers the upper slit. Using the paraxial approximation, draw the setup and find the fringe spacing, added phase difference and displacement of the tracked zero-order fringe. Is the original screen center bright or dark, and does the final unlabeled intensity pattern differ from before?
assumptions: Light is monochromatic and coherent; slits identical and narrow.
Film covers only the upper slit and introduces no absorption or tilt.
Wavelength 500 nm is the vacuum/air wavelength; refractive index of air ≈ 1.
Positive y direction is toward the upper (covered) slit.

qualitativeClaims.claim: Fringe spacing is unchanged by the film because β depends only on λ, L, d.
Film adds optical path (n−1)t to the upper slit, giving constant added phase Δφ = 4π rad (two full wavelengths of path).
Zero-order fringe shifts toward the covered (upper) slit by y₀ = L(n−1)t/d = 4 mm, i.e. 2 fringe spacings.
At the original screen center the path difference is now (n−1)t = 2λ, so the center is bright (constructive interference).
The unlabeled intensity pattern is identical to before: a uniform shift by exactly 2β maps the fringe set onto itself, so only tracked fringe labels change.
qualitativeClaims.expected: I(y) = I₀cos²(πd(y−y₀)/(λL)) with y₀ = 2β; same set of bright/dark positions

qualitativeClaims.claim: Paraxial geometry: slits separated by d along vertical y axis, screen at distance L, fringe position y ≈ L sinθ ≈ L(mλ − (n−1)t)/d.
